import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static void bubble_sort(int[] arr, int len) {
        for (int i = 1; i < len; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= len - i; j++)
                if (arr[j] > arr[j + 1]) {
                    int tmp = arr[j];
                    arr[j] = arr[j + 1];
                    arr[j + 1] = tmp;
                }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        bubble_sort(a, n);
        System.out.println(a[(n + 1) / 2]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
